properties.evidence: Same cause, twenty-one days earlier, and that instance cost a day of dogfooding with five merged PRs never running through a live session. It reached its own conclusion — that the documented remedy (restart) is the thing that fails under `--shared` — and stopped at naming the remedy rather than asking why the client attaches to a mismatched daemon at all. Drawn to make the recurrence visible from the cause: the same fix answers both, and neither is answered by changing the installer.
